entries.zh: 可賞：值得獎賞、可嘉獎；予以褒賞
entries.en: to be worthy of reward; praiseworthy, commendable

entries.zh: 賞賜：上位者頒給獎賞、恩賞
entries.en: to bestow a reward, to grant a bounty (from a superior)

entries.zh: 封賞：封爵並賜予賞賜
entries.en: to confer rank together with rewards; to reward with title and gifts

entries.zh: 敕封：奉敕命封賜（如上帝或國王之封）
entries.en: to confer by edict (as God or the King confers)

entries.zh: 敕賜：奉敕命賞賜、御賜
entries.en: to bestow by edict; to grant by royal/divine authority

entries.zh: 賞善罰惡：獎賞善人、懲罰惡人
entries.en: to reward the good and punish the wicked

entries.zh: 善有善報：行善必得善報
entries.en: the good are repaid with good; good deeds bring good returns

entries.zh: 誥封：以誥命封贈官爵（恩澤及於其子）
entries.en: to confer a title by imperial patent (extending to one's son/heirs)
entries.notes: L 欄文句訛脫（ael hijo los mejores），義憑 H「誥封」與 M co hong 定。

entries.zh: 襲蔭：承襲父祖恩蔭、世襲餘澤而得官爵
entries.en: to inherit hereditary privilege; to succeed to a family's conferred rank
entries.notes: M 第二音節聲調記號 T99 污損，然 H 與 L 義相合。

entries.zh: 封贈：因子孫顯貴而為其親長請封、追贈
entries.en: to confer honorific rank on one's parents through a son's official position
entries.notes: L 欄縮寫 S⁰（當為 Señor）須展開，義憑 H「封贈」與 L「por el hijo mandarín」定。

entries.zh: 犒勞：以財物酒食慰勞酬謝其功
entries.en: to reward labour; to give a bounty or treat in return for service

entries.zh: 惡有惡報：為惡終得惡報、惡行受惡報
entries.en: evil is repaid with evil; the recompense of evil for evil

entries.zh: 當：典當、抵押；亦指典押行為
entries.en: to pawn, to give in pledge; a pledge

entries.zh: 當頭：典押之物、抵押品
entries.en: a pawned article, a pledge, security left in pawn

entries.zh: 古記：舊物、紀念物；定情與留念之信物
entries.en: a keepsake, memento; a token of love and remembrance
entries.notes: H 作「古記」，閩南語指舊物、紀念物，與 L「prenda de amor & memoria」義合。

entries.zh: 捕捉、擒拿（強力抓住）
entries.en: to seize, to catch hold of (by force)
entries.notes: H 欄作「扨」，疑為「掠」之形訛；M 欄「lia lia gin por fuerza」混入西語說明，音寫不純。

entries.zh: 拘：拘留、拘禁、拘押
entries.en: to detain, to confine, to hold in custody
entries.notes: H 僅作「拘」，而 M 作 cu hey（含「提」音），疑原稿 H 欄為「拘提」之省。

entries.zh: 提：提拿、拘拿人犯（押解到官）
entries.en: to take a person into custody and bring him forward
entries.notes: M 作 chiog hey，與 H「提」對音不合，疑 H 欄或為「捉」類字；L 義與 H 亦未密合。

entries.zh: 捕：捕魚、捕捞（捉取魚類）
entries.en: to catch fish, to take fish

entries.zh: 拘提：官府拘拿人犯並押解到案
entries.en: to arrest a person and bring him in; to take into custody for trial
